d:
Delhi Police's internal protest has now turned into a legal controversy after videos featuring alleged remarks against lawyers went viral.
The Delhi High Court has asked the Centre to examine the videos and consider removing the objectionable content, if necessary.
Suspended ACP Manasvi Vashisht and another police officer are facing allegations over remarks and threats allegedly made against lawyers.
The controversy began following a clash between lawyers and police personnel in Shahdara and subsequent protests outside Delhi Police Headquarters.
